@ a bundle given to a port at sample * 2 is its two elements of the frame: 2 x - 1 + 10 (2 x) = 22 x - 1, in any of the forms that pass it
@ the elements of a bundle keep their order through a flow that takes and gives one, and two ports of two sizes are two bundles
@ a value that is no bundle given to a port at sample * N is N elements of that value, the value of the frame (S-1214 (3))
@ the elements of a bundle need no Default: a Char bundle, a Char constant and a stereo bundle pass
@ a call that takes a bundle in an if~ arm, in a par~ body and in a part of a .down~ is read as everywhere else, and the arm that is not taken goes on
@ the time of the call that gives the bundle is the frame number: its elements are 2 k and 2 k + 1
@ an output at sample * 8 under .down~(2) is a bundle at sample * 4: the first 4 elements go to the frame of the tick and the next 4 to the frame after it
@ an output at sample * 8 under two .down~(2) is a bundle at sample * 2: two elements to each of the 4 frames of the run
@ a bundle of 4 elements a frame given to a port at sample * 8 under .down~(2) is gathered from the 2 frames before the tick
@ a bundle that goes by and a bundle that a .down~(2) deals, in one call and after a reset at a frame between two ticks of the head
- the calls of process cut the run anywhere, a call of 0 frames too: the same values for a bundle that goes by and one that is dealt by a .down~(2) (§13.4)
- twelve calls of one frame give the same
- reset after any number of frames, at a tick of the head or between: the state of the bundle, the dealt array and the time are those of a state just made
